subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Should maintainers require a fresh live native iOS/WebChat reproduction on current main before authorizing a fix PR for this issue?
rationale: The issue has strong release-level user evidence and clear source surfaces, but current main only proves an adjacent CLI diagnostic improvement and the remaining root cause may span iOS WebSocket dispatch, node-event ingress, Gateway chat routing, or restart/session recovery.

options.title: Run live iOS repro first
options.body: Use a current-main or nightly Gateway plus the official iOS app to capture `chat.send`, `agent.wait`, transcript, and `chat.history` evidence before opening a fix PR.

options.title: Fold into restart-recovery scope
options.body: Treat the remaining work as part of the WebChat session/restart ownership cluster only if the live repro shows the same boot or dead-session route state as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99346.

options.title: Authorize a focused fix PR now
options.body: Allow a narrow repair against the iOS/Gateway ingress path from the existing evidence, accepting that the first PR may need follow-up if live proof shows a different failing step.

recommendation.title: Run live iOS repro first
recommendation.body: Use a current-main or nightly Gateway plus the official iOS app to capture `chat.send`, `agent.wait`, transcript, and `chat.history` evidence before opening a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has adjacent WebChat source-reply history plus recent merge ownership on the node-event ingress path.
